font_stack: Inter via next/font/google (app/layout.tsx); single face, display aliases body
palette: OKLCH channel triples in app/globals.css; Tailwind consumes oklch(var(--x) / <alpha-value>)
motion: motion-cut — no framer-motion/gsap/motion; CSS transitions only, prefers-reduced-motion honored
spacing: 4pt scale, hand-rolled in platform.css (not Tailwind extend.spacing)
notes: Two route groups: app/(marketing) is the public entry surface (/ and /signin) and is the ONLY place landing composition is allowed — see DESIGN.md §10. app/(platform) is the dense operational app; use audit/redesign/component verbs there, never the greenfield flow. Gotchas: platform.css styles bare table/th/td globally (nowrap + ellipsis + uppercase headers) so any new prose table must reset them; next/image needs max-width:100% or it lays out at intrinsic width. No visual regression suite — class names are the regression surface, do not rename them.
